system.description: You maintain a constant background sense of the moods and attitudes of those around you. Anyone speaking with you must truthfully answer generic emotional questions, and lying to you requires the liar to win a Mental Challenge (ties favor you). If someone tries to con you with Subterfuge or similar Social Challenges, you may spend a Blood Trait and win a Mental Challenge to realize it. You cannot be surprised within a 10-foot radius unless distracted or impaired, though this offers no protection from ranged sniping. Those with eight or more Willpower Traits or the Iron Will Merit may shield their thoughts with conscious effort, detectable if their concentration is broken.
